kind: tracked repair table for the mechanically templated particle rows of the mined N3 Layer-B
target: research/derived/mined_layerb_n3/batch-*.json, already ingested; apply keyed on (key, position)
inputs: research/derived/n3_mined/layerb_derived/batch-01..30.json  (pre-verification, holds the raw pair modal for every function_pt)

scope.templated_label_definition: assembled function_pt is byte-identical to the pair modal the derivation wrote, whatever function_status now says

explanation_change.replace: set explanation_pt to new_explanation; explanation_status stays 'template'
explanation_change.withdraw: set explanation_pt to null and explanation_status to 'author'; the row returns to the authoring queue

function_pt_change.replace: set function_pt to new_function_pt and function_status to 'occurrence-rule'

how_to_apply.overrides_verified: true means the row's function_status is already 'verified' or 'corrected'. The label was still the raw pair modal and the verified explanation_pt usually contradicts it in words, but applying these overwrites a human/agent verdict: hold them for sign-off rather than applying blind.

chunk-adverb-dropped.what: An adverb (副詞) standing in front of the noun phrase was quoted as part of it. The adverb modifies the predicate, not the noun, so it leaves the quoted chunk.
chunk-adverb-dropped.kept_when: the adverb sits in front of another predicate word (より強力な, そういう), where it modifies that word and the word is inside the phrase.

chunk-adverbial-noun-dropped.what: A 副詞可能 noun (明日, 昨日, 毎月, 最近) in a non-head slot was quoted inside the noun phrase. It is a clause adjunct and leaves the chunk.
chunk-adverbial-noun-dropped.kept_when: it IS the head (明日は…), or the head is a bound noun that cannot stand alone (土曜以外, 一人分).

chunk-adverbial-copula-dropped.what: The 連用形 copula に / で (急に, 非常に, 確かに, ので) is tagged 助動詞, not 助詞, so the v1 walk sailed straight through it and swallowed the adverb before it.
chunk-adverbial-copula-dropped.kept_when: the copula is 連体形 (きれいな花): there it really does modify the noun.

chunk-verbal-adverbial-dropped.what: A 連用形 i-adjective used adverbially (早く目, 良く日) was quoted inside the noun phrase.
chunk-verbal-adverbial-dropped.kept_when: the predicate continues to its right (良くする案, やりたいこと, 引退した後), or the form is 語幹 (薄暮れ), or a 連用形 VERB heads a compound (焼き加減).

chunk-conjunction-dropped.what: A sentence connector (そして, すなわち, また, さて, 一方) was quoted as part of the noun phrase that follows it.
chunk-conjunction-dropped.kept_when: never; a 接続詞 is never inside a noun phrase.

chunk-other-dropped.what: Some other non-modifier token left the chunk.

te-locution-withdraw.what: て inside a fixed compound postposition (として, について, によって, に対して, にとって, に関して, に基づいて, AからBにかけて …). These tokenize as 助詞 + 動詞 + て, so the connector template claimed 'て liga とる ao que vem depois', naming a verb that is not doing that job. The template is withdrawn; the row goes back to authoring (explanation_status: author).
te-locution-withdraw.kept_when: an auxiliary follows the て (必要としている, 事実に基づいている, 位置についていた, 脇によってください): those are a real verb plus real aspect.

label-copula-de.what: で before ない / ある is the copula of ではない・でもある. The pair modal calls every 格助詞 で 'partícula de lugar da ação'.
label-copula-de.kept_when: anything else follows the で (書斎で仕事, 海の中では様々な…).

label-total-negation-mo.what: も after an interrogative (何, 誰, どこ) or a minimizer (少し, 一言, 一度) in a negative clause is total negation, not the 'também' of inclusion.
label-total-negation-mo.kept_when: no negation in the clause, or the word before is not one of those (私も人間です). どうも is excluded: it is an adverb, not an interrogative.

label-spatial-made.what: まで on a non-time nominal with a verb of motion or extent in the clause (頂上まで登る, 岸まで泳ぐ, 部屋まで運ぶ) is a limit in space, not in time.
label-spatial-made.kept_when: no motion verb. クリスマスまで and 第二次大戦まで look identical to a parser, so the rule stays silent rather than guess.

label-comitative-to.what: と between nominals, before 一緒に or a reciprocal verb (話す, 会う, 戦う, 比べる), marks the other party. The pair modal calls every 格助詞 と quotative.
label-comitative-to.kept_when: the left side is だ / a closing quote mark, or the verb is quotative (と言う, という, と呼ぶ).

label-adverbial-ni.what: に on a na-adjective stem or an adverbial stem (本当に, 実際に, 順番に, 一緒に) in front of a verb builds an adverb; it is not a destination.
label-adverbial-ni.kept_when: the verb is なる / する (病気になる, 名選手にする): that is the resultative pair, a third reading this rule does not claim.

label-na-emphasis.what: Sentence-final な after だ / です / an i-adjective / たい (期間だな, 欲しいな, 洗いたいな) is emphasis. Only a plain-form VERB in front of it makes it a prohibition.
label-na-emphasis.kept_when: the word before is a verb in 終止形 or 連体形 (読むな, 悩むな). Sudachi's pick between those two in front of a 終助詞 is arbitrary, so both count.

label-na-soft-order.what: Sentence-final な on a 連用形 verb stem (行きな) is the soft order 〜なさい, not a prohibition.
label-na-soft-order.kept_when: the verb is in plain form.
